_comment: Cases that kill the runtime with a signal, per suite, as of the last canonical sweep. A crash is not one more failing case: it is the runtime dying on input a user could write, so this number is ratcheted separately from the pass rate and is only allowed to go DOWN. tools/check-crash-budget.mjs enforces it.

known: test-signal-args.js: sends itself SIGINT; milojs has no process.on('SIGINT'), so the default action kills it
